notes: State expectations come from games/auction-house/tests/model.py (upstream rules 3.0.0). The only emulator-derived input is origin, upstream's entropy(): each market start samples the title-song position, logged at 0x4720 (count, values) and fed to the model in order; every other byte is the model's prediction. Each market follows the choices found by plan() for its origin; synthetic-all-markets clears all three. synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000.
